text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Here, a crescendo, and then a 
high-pitched, passionate vibrato...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Doloroso! No! This isn't how it should 
sound!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What a disaster... A mismatched triplet... 
The sound isn't turning out the way I 
envisioned at all...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Is it the pressure from my fingertips...? 
Or maybe something's wrong with my 
ears...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth might have accumulated 
considerable fatigue from consecutive 
races. I should probably reconsider our 
schedule.
